name: Datang Environment Industry Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Datang Environment Industry Group Co., Ltd. provides environmental protection and energy conservation solutions to coal-fired power generation enterprises in the People's Republic of China. It operates through the following segments: Environmental Protection and Energy Conservation Solutions, Renewable Energy Engineering, Thermal Power Engineering, and Other Businesses.
